title: TCS Q1 FY27 Earnings: Navigating Growth Amidst Margin Pressures
description: Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) reported a consolidated net profit of ₹13,349 crore for Q1 FY27, a 4.6% year-on-year increase. Revenue from operations grew 14.

faq.q: What was TCS's net profit for Q1 FY27?
faq.a: TCS reported a consolidated net profit of ₹13,349 crore for Q1 FY27, which is a 4.6% increase year-on-year. However, it saw a sequential decline of 2.7% from the previous quarter.

faq.q: How much revenue did TCS generate in Q1 FY27?
faq.a: TCS generated ₹72,275 crore in revenue from operations for Q1 FY27, marking a 14% year-on-year growth. This also represents a 2.2% sequential increase in rupee terms.

faq.q: Why did TCS's operating margin decline in Q1 FY27?
faq.a: The operating margin declined by 130 basis points sequentially to 24.0% primarily due to the annual wage hikes rolled out for the global workforce and continued investments in AI capabilities.

faq.q: What was the value of new deals secured by TCS in this quarter?
faq.a: TCS secured a total contract value (TCV) of $9.5 billion in Q1 FY27, which included a significant AI-led business transformation deal with SKF.

faq.q: What is TCS's strategy regarding Artificial Intelligence (AI)?
faq.a: TCS is actively investing in AI capabilities, securing AI-led transformation deals, and forming strategic partnerships with AI companies. Its annualised AI services revenue reached $2.6 billion in Q1 FY27, growing 13.6% quarter-on-quarter.

faq.q: Did TCS declare a dividend for Q1 FY27?
faq.a: Yes, the board of directors declared an interim dividend of ₹12 per equity share for FY27. The record date for determining shareholder eligibility was fixed as July 15.
